verses.text: The elder unto Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
verses.marked_text: The elder unto Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

verses.text: Beloved, I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
verses.marked_text: Beloved, I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

verses.text: For I rejoiced greatly, when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth, even as thou walkest in truth.
verses.marked_text: For I rejoiced greatly, when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth, even as thou walkest in truth.

verses.text: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.
verses.marked_text: Greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth.

verses.text: Beloved, thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal;
verses.marked_text: Beloved, thou doest a faithful work in whatsoever thou doest toward them that are brethren and strangers withal;

verses.text: who bare witness to thy love before the church: whom thou wilt do well to set forward on their journey worthily of God:
verses.marked_text: who bare witness to thy love before the church: whom thou wilt do well to set forward on their journey worthily of God:

verses.text: because that for the sake of the Name they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.marked_text: because that for the sake of the Name they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

verses.text: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.
verses.marked_text: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.

verses.text: I wrote somewhat unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
verses.marked_text: I wrote somewhat unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

verses.text: Therefore, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he doeth, prating against us with wicked words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and them that would he forbiddeth and casteth them out of the church.
verses.marked_text: Therefore, if I come, I will bring to remembrance his works which he doeth, prating against us with wicked words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and them that would he forbiddeth and casteth them out of the church.

verses.text: Beloved, imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
verses.marked_text: Beloved, imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

verses.text: Demetrius hath the witness of all men , and of the truth itself: yea, we also bear witness; and thou knowest that our witness is true.
verses.marked_text: Demetrius hath the witness of all men , and of the truth itself: yea, we also bear witness; and thou knowest that our witness is true.

verses.text: I had many things to write unto thee, but I am unwilling to write them to thee with ink and pen:
verses.marked_text: I had many things to write unto thee, but I am unwilling to write them to thee with ink and pen:

verses.text: but I hope shortly to see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be unto thee. The friends salute thee. Salute the friends by name.
verses.marked_text: but I hope shortly to see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be unto thee. The friends salute thee. Salute the friends by name.
